title: Quick Queso-Less Brazilian Tomatoes Bake
description: A festive Brazilian dish featuring vine tomatoes, bake, and a dairy-free twist. Perfect for weeknights or special occasions.

ingredients.name: Vine Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Heirloom or cherry tomatoes work well.

instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 425°F (220°C).
Prepare the vine tomatoes by slicing them into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut oil, almond butter, garlic, salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Add the sliced tomatoes to the bowl and toss them to coat with the spice mixture.
Place the coated tomatoes in the preheated tandoor clay pot.
Drizzle lime juice over the tomatoes and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Cover the clay pot with a lid and bake for 25 minutes or until the tomatoes are tender and slightly charred.
Serve warm, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
